name: smwmusic-machinations-m-t-opolitaines
title: Machinations Météopolitaines
description:
"You're walking through the big city, lost in thought. But, looking around, things aren't quite so bad when you're here."

A joint composition between icrawfish and bebn legg that won 4th place at Super Famicompo 4. We took turns composing and porting each part, which was lots of fun, and this fusion of a piece was the result.

We came up with the title by combining some themes the song reminded us, like cities and machines, but also seasonal/weathery vibes, and brought that over to French to come up with "Machinations Météopolitaines" (the second word being a combination of "météo" meaning weather, and "métropolitain", or metropolitan).
